pairs.target: mǐlā lái jiè tǎ wéi de jiù wàiyī shí , tā yǐwéi zìjǐ tīngcuò le . " búshì chuān . diàn xiāng jiǎo . " tā shuō , " nǐ nà jiàn bǔ dé hòu , mópò le yě búhuì xīnténg . "
pairs.english: When Mira came to borrow Tavi's old coat, he thought he had misheard. “Not to wear. To pad the crate corners,” she said. “Yours is thick with patches. You won't mind if it wears through.”
pairs.hanzi:
米拉来借塔维的旧外衣时，他以为自己听错了。
“不是穿。垫箱角。”她说，“你那件补得厚，磨破了也不会心疼。”

pairs.target: sū yǐ zhàn zài tā shēnhòu , shǒushàng ná zhe liǎngzhāng gài guò zuōfang yìn de zhǐ . yìzhāng zhǔnxǔ tāmen bǎ yàngjiàn dài chūqù , yìzhāng jì zhe fùzé suíxíng de táoshīfu hé sān rén de fǎnxiào rìqī .
pairs.english: Suyi stood behind her holding two workshop-stamped sheets. One allowed them to take the prototype away; the other recorded Master Tao, responsible for accompanying them, and the three students' return date.
pairs.hanzi: 苏苡站在她身后，手上拿着两张盖过作坊印的纸。一张准许她们把样件带出去，一张记着负责随行的陶师傅和三人的返校日期。

pairs.target: mǐlā fùqīn yǐ bǎ xīn tú nájǐ shuǐkǒu páng de jǐhù rén kànguò , huíxìn shuō yuànyì ràng tāmen shì bǎi , dàn xiān biédòng yuánlái de mùcáo . shíjiān yuē zài hòutiān , tāmen zuò zǎochē guòqù , zhù liǎngyè , dìsāntiān xiàwǔ huílái .
pairs.english: Mira's father had shown the new drawing to several households beside the intake. His reply said they were willing to let them try positioning it, but to leave the original wooden channel alone. It was arranged for the day after tomorrow: an early cart out, two nights there, back on the third afternoon.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉父亲已把新图拿给水口旁的几户人看过，回信说愿意让她们试摆，但先别动原来的木槽。时间约在后天，她们坐早车过去，住两夜，第三天下午回来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dāying tóngháng , réng bǎ nà jiàn wàiyī xiān cóng xiāngzǐ xiàmiàn chōu huílái , mōlemō lǐngkǒu . mǐlā wèn zěnme , yòu lìkè shuō bú jiè yě xíng .
pairs.english: Tavi agreed to come, but first pulled the coat from beneath the box and felt its collar. Mira asked what was wrong, then immediately said he needn't lend it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维答应同行，仍把那件外衣先从箱子下面抽回来，摸了摸领口。米拉问怎么，又立刻说不借也行。

pairs.target: " jiè . " tā shuō , " wǒ xiān bǎ kòuzǐ chāi le . diàn huài le yīfu , kòuzǐ hái néng yòng . "
pairs.english: “I'll lend it,” he said. “Let me take the buttons off first. If the padding ruins the coat, the buttons will still be useful.”
pairs.hanzi: “借。”他说，“我先把扣子拆了。垫坏了衣服，扣子还能用。”

pairs.target: chūfā nàtiān , táoshīfu bǎ liǎnggè mùxiāng ān zài chēwěi , zhōngjiān sāijìn cǎo shù . tǎ wéi yuán xiǎng zài jiè yìdiǎn xìng , bǎ kǎ dé tàijǐn de xiāo nòng sōng , shǒu hái méi shēnguòqù , biàn xiǎngqǐ xiāngzǐ búshì kètáng shàng nà duì pèi hǎo de tiě jiàn .
pairs.english: On departure day, Master Tao secured two wooden crates at the back of the cart, stuffing straw bundles between them. Tavi thought of borrowing properties to loosen an overly tight pin, but before reaching out remembered the crate wasn't the matched iron pair from class.
pairs.hanzi: 出发那天，陶师傅把两个木箱安在车尾，中间塞进草束。塔维原想再借一点性，把卡得太紧的销弄松，手还没伸过去，便想起箱子不是课堂上那对配好的铁件。

pairs.target: tā gǎi ná xiǎo mùchuí , zhào shīfu zhǐ de wèizhì qīngqiāo . mǐlā zài pángbiān fú xiāng , méiyǒu cuī .
pairs.english: Instead he took a small mallet and tapped lightly where the master pointed. Mira steadied the crate beside him without hurrying him.
pairs.hanzi: 他改拿小木槌，照师傅指的位置轻敲。米拉在旁边扶箱，没有催。

pairs.target: shānlù yìchū chéng jiù biànzhǎi . chēlún yā guò héngpái de páishuǐ shí , sāngè rén dé tóngshí tái yíxià pìgǔ , cái búzhìyú yáchǐ pèng yáchǐ .
pairs.english: The mountain road narrowed as soon as they left the city. When the wheels crossed rows of drainage stones, all three had to lift their bottoms together to avoid their teeth clacking.
pairs.hanzi: 山路一出城就变窄。车轮压过横排的排水石，三个人得同时抬一下屁股，才不至于牙齿碰牙齿。

pairs.target: sū yǐ qǐchū hái bǎ cǎotú tān zài xī shàng , dìsāncì diānbǒ hòu , mòmò juàn le qǐlái . mǐlā xiào tā dìyīcì lái bù zhīdào , huàyīn cái luò , zìjǐ étóu zhuàng zài le chēpéng shàng .
pairs.english: Suyi initially kept the sketch spread across her knees; after the third jolt, she silently rolled it up. Mira laughed that she didn't know better on her first visit, then immediately struck her own forehead against the canopy.
pairs.hanzi: 苏苡起初还把草图摊在膝上，第三次颠簸后，默默卷了起来。米拉笑她第一次来不知道，话音才落，自己额头撞在了车篷上。

pairs.target: línjìn zhōngwǔ , tāmen dào le yǎnglù zhù qū . dīǎi wūzi yán pō āizhe , ménwài dàduō kàozhe chángbǐng chǎn hé bǔguò de luókuāng .
pairs.english: Around noon they reached the road workers' settlement. Low houses stood close along the slope, most doors flanked by long-handled shovels and patched baskets.
pairs.hanzi: 临近中午，他们到了养路住区。低矮屋子沿坡挨着，门外大多靠着长柄铲和补过的箩筐。

pairs.target: mǐlā zhǐ gěi tǎ wéi kàn zìjǐ xiǎoshíhòu shuāiduàn yá de táijiē , yòu zhǐ yípiàn píngdì , shuō yǐqián zài nàlǐ sàichē , yòng de shì càikuāng , shuí yě bùkěn chéngrèn shū shìyīnwèi kuāng wāi .
pairs.english: Mira showed Tavi the steps where she had broken a tooth as a child, then a patch of level ground where they used to race in vegetable baskets; nobody would admit losing because their basket was crooked.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉指给塔维看自己小时候摔断牙的台阶，又指一片平地，说以前在那里赛车，用的是菜筐，谁也不肯承认输是因为筐歪。

pairs.target: tā fùqīn zài chàkǒu děng , xiān bāng táoshīfu bān xiāngzǐ , cái shēnshǒu pāi nǚér de tóu . tā duǒkāi le , děng tā zhuǎnshēn yòu chēn zhí zìjǐ bèi pāi luàn de yīlǐng .
pairs.english: Her father waited at the junction, helping Master Tao with the crates before reaching out to pat his daughter's head. She ducked away, then straightened her rumpled collar when he turned.
pairs.hanzi: 她父亲在岔口等，先帮陶师傅搬箱子，才伸手拍女儿的头。她躲开了，等他转身又抻直自己被拍乱的衣领。

pairs.target: shuǐkǒu zài zhù qū xiàfāng , ràoguò yìzhū lǎo shù cái kàndéjiàn . móxíng lǐ nà kē shù zhǐyǒu yìgēn zhǐtou gāo , zhēnde shùgēn què cóng shífèng zhōng gǒng chūlái , tiēzhe jiù cáo de yícè shēn dào pō xià .
pairs.english: The intake lay below the settlement, out of sight until they rounded an old tree. In the model that tree was only a finger high; real roots bulged from stone cracks and ran beside the old channel down the slope.
pairs.hanzi: 水口在住区下方，绕过一株老树才看得见。模型里那棵树只有一根指头高，真的树根却从石缝中拱出来，贴着旧槽的一侧伸到坡下。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bào zhe gōngjù rào le liǎngbù , zhōngyú zhīdào tú shàng nà kuài méiyǒu huà dōngxī de kòngbái , yuánlái huì ràng rén de jiǎo méi dìfāng luò .
pairs.english: Carrying the tools, Tavi took a couple of steps around it and finally understood: that empty space on the drawing could leave nowhere to put your feet.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维抱着工具绕了两步，终于知道图上那块没有画东西的空白，原来会让人的脚没地方落。

pairs.target: sānhù yòngshuǐ de rén yǐ zài pángbiān děng zhe . qízhōng yíwèi juànxiù de fùrén ná zhe zìjiā de liǎngzhī tǒng , zhǐ gěi sū yǐ kàn píngcháng zhàn nǎér , zhuāngmǎn hòu yòu cóng nǎbiān tí zǒu .
pairs.english: Three water-using households were waiting nearby. A woman with rolled sleeves held her own two buckets, showing Suyi where she normally stood and which way she carried them off when full.
pairs.hanzi: 三户用水的人已在旁边等着。其中一位卷袖的妇人拿着自家的两只桶，指给苏苡看平常站哪儿，装满后又从哪边提走。

pairs.target: sū yǐ bǎ dìshàng bǎi yàngjiàn de wèizhì nuókāi , gěi tā liúchū tōnglù , cái qǐng táoshīfu jiǎnchá néngfǒu ānfàng . " zhèlǐ běnlái néng zǒu liǎnggè rén . " fùrén shuō .
pairs.english: Suyi moved the prototype's position aside to leave her a path, then asked Master Tao to check whether it could be placed there. “Two people used to fit through here,” the woman said.
pairs.hanzi:
苏苡把地上摆样件的位置挪开，给她留出通路，才请陶师傅检查能否安放。
“这里本来能走两个人。”妇人说。

pairs.target: mǐlā jiěshì kuàngjià búhuì dīng shàng jiù cáo , kěyǐ chāi . fùrén yáotóu , shuō tā tīngdǒng le , kě chāi dé xiàlái hé xiànzài dǎng bu dǎnglù , shì liǎnghuíshì .
pairs.english: Mira explained that the frame wouldn't be nailed to the old channel and could be removed. The woman shook her head: she understood, but being removable and blocking the path now were two different things.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉解释框架不会钉上旧槽，可以拆。妇人摇头，说她听懂了，可拆得下来和现在挡不挡路，是两回事。

pairs.target: mǐlā dūn zhe kàn le bàntiān , liǎnshàng jiànjiàn méi le gāng dào shí de xiào . tā fùqīn xiǎng bāng tā shuōhuà , sū yǐ xiān bǎ lìng yìgēn zhī jiǎo bānhuílái , tíyì kào shàngpō yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: Mira crouched studying it for a long while, her arrival smile gradually fading. Her father wanted to speak for her, but Suyi first moved another support leg back, suggesting they go a little farther uphill.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉蹲着看了半天，脸上渐渐没了刚到时的笑。她父亲想帮她说话，苏苡先把另一根支脚搬回来，提议靠上坡一点。

pairs.target: táoshīfu liáng guò dìmiàn , zhǎo liǎngkuài wěn shí diànpíng , xiāng jià zhōngyú zài bú pèng jiù cáo de dìfāng zhànzhù .
pairs.english: Master Tao measured the ground and leveled it with two stable stones; at last the crate frame stood without touching the old channel.
pairs.hanzi: 陶师傅量过地面，找两块稳石垫平，箱架终于在不碰旧槽的地方站住。

pairs.target: tǎ wéihé mǐlā qù tíshuǐ , cái zǒu dào lǎo shù bèimiàn , tā tūrán tíngxià . " wǒ zhīdào tā búshì zhǎochá . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: Tavi and Mira went for water. Just behind the old tree, she suddenly stopped. “I know she isn't picking on me,” she said.
pairs.hanzi:
塔维和米拉去提水，才走到老树背面，她突然停下。
“我知道她不是找茬。”她说。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi děng le yíxià , jiàn tā méiyǒu wǎng xià jiǎng , biàn wèn tǒng gē nǎbiān . mǐlā zhǐzhe shùgēn jiān yíkuài píng shí , zìjǐ xiān fàng xiàlái .
pairs.english: Tavi waited a moment, then, seeing she wasn't going on, asked where to set the bucket. Mira pointed to a flat stone among the roots and put hers down first.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维等了一下，见她没有往下讲，便问桶搁哪边。米拉指着树根间一块平石，自己先放下来。

pairs.target: " kě wǒ zài jiāménkǒu bèi zhème shuō , háishì hěn diūliǎn . " " tā kàn nǐ de xiāngzǐ , yòu méi kàn nǐ de liǎn . " mǐlā bái tā yìyǎn , guò le yíhuìer , què xiào le . " nǐ ānwèi rén de běnshì , yě dé liàn . "
pairs.english: “But being told that on my own doorstep is still embarrassing.” “She was looking at your crate, not your face.” Mira rolled her eyes at him, then laughed after a moment. “Your comforting skills need practice too.”
pairs.hanzi:
“可我在家门口被这么说，还是很丢脸。”
“她看你的箱子，又没看你的脸。”
米拉白他一眼，过了一会儿，却笑了。“你安慰人的本事，也得练。”

pairs.target: xiàwǔ méiyǒu jiētōng shìyòng . tāmen xiān qǐng nà fùrén tí kōngtǒng , mǎn tǒng gè zǒu yìhuí , zài bǎ tí bǎ hé jiǎoxià wèizhì biāo gěi táoshīfu kàn .
pairs.english: They didn't connect it for a trial that afternoon. First they asked the woman to walk through with empty and full buckets, then marked the handle and footing positions for Master Tao.
pairs.hanzi: 下午没有接通试用。他们先请那妇人提空桶、满桶各走一回，再把提把和脚下位置标给陶师傅看。

pairs.target: sū yǐ jiānchí zìjǐ zuò wán zuìhòu yìzǔ jìlù , méi ràng mǐlā fùqīn yíjù " nǐmen liǎnggè yātou dōu xīnkǔ " bǎ míngzì hùnguòqù .
pairs.english: Suyi insisted on completing the final records herself, refusing to let Mira's father's “Both you girls have worked hard” blur their names together.
pairs.hanzi: 苏苡坚持自己做完最后一组记录，没让米拉父亲一句“你们两个丫头都辛苦”把名字混过去。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn , mǐlā mǔqīn duān chū yìpén jiān dé jiāohuáng de bǐng . mǐlā zuǐ shàng shuō láibùjí , shǒu què yíxià ná le liǎngkuài , bǎ dìyīkuài sāi gěi sū yǐ .
pairs.english: At dusk Mira's mother brought out a dish of golden fried flatbreads. Mira said there was no time, yet instantly took two, pressing the first into Suyi's hand.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚，米拉母亲端出一盆煎得焦黄的饼。米拉嘴上说来不及，手却一下拿了两块，把第一块塞给苏苡。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gāng shēnshǒu , tā yòu shōuhuí pén , shuō diàn xiāngzǐ de yīfu hái méi hái , xiān suàn yā zài zhèlǐ . tā zhǐhǎo jǔ zhe kōng wǎn , děng tā xiào gòu .
pairs.english: Just as Tavi reached out, she withdrew the dish: the coat padding the crate hadn't been returned, so this was collateral for now. He could only hold his empty bowl and wait until she had laughed enough.
pairs.hanzi:
塔维刚伸手，她又收回盆，说垫箱子的衣服还没还，先算押在这里。
他只好举着空碗，等她笑够。
